description: Rename a tag, change its color, or both. Pass name, color or both. A rename changes the tag on every contact that carries it, starts no sequences, and returns contactsUpdated. A tag on more than 20,000 contacts returns status processing instead: the name is saved and the contacts follow within minutes, during which other renames, merges and deletes are refused (409 tag_in_progress; list_tags shows changeInProgress). It is refused (409, with a usage list) while a sequence, segment, campaign, email, sync rule, goal or integration still uses the tag, and when another tag already has the name: use merge_tags for that. System tags cannot be updated.

color.description: New tag color. Required unless name is given.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name.description: New tag name. Stored lowercase with hyphens. Required unless color is given.

tagId.description: Tag ID. Use list_tags to find tag IDs.

name: update_tag

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_tag` MCP tool.

contactsUpdated.description: Contacts whose tag was renamed. Present only when name was given and status is completed.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

status.description: completed, or processing when the tag is on more than 20,000 contacts and they are still being moved. Present only when name was given.

tag.description: The tag record returned by Sequenzy.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
